summary: Minimal test suite with only 3 happy-path fixtures (mixed, docs-only, none) and no coverage of core requirements: glob pattern edge cases, priority ordering logic, multiple labels per file, rule validation, malformed input handling, or error scenarios. Tests structure.bats covers workflow YAML validation and actionlint checks well, but workflow.bats lacks depth. No unit tests of label-assigner.sh directly (though explicitly required by workflow-only constraint). No boundary conditions (empty input, special characters, large inputs, conflicting patterns) tested. All 5 tests depend on single setup_file run, reducing isolation. Test fixtures referenced but not documented—unclear what each fixture verifies beyond label count. Would not catch regressions in glob matching, priority deduplication, rule parsing, or error handling.
